shared_prompt_blocks.art_direction: dark gothic fantasy, realistic high-fidelity game character matching the HD Character & Monster Design Template; physically based materials (embroidered cloth, dented dark plate armor, worn leather, skin, cracked stone, magic energy); worn edges and grime
shared_prompt_blocks.concept_view: full body, centered, three-quarter front view, arms slightly away from the body (A-pose for humanoids), whole silhouette visible with margin
shared_prompt_blocks.lighting: flat even studio light, no cast shadows, no rim light, no fog
shared_prompt_blocks.exclude: text, labels, logo, watermark, frame, scenery, ground, multiple characters, cropped limbs, cartoon or anime style, sci-fi elements, original 1994 sprite look
shared_prompt_blocks.img2img: Use the asset's FRONT view, cropped from its panel on the design map, as the init image at denoise 0.45-0.6 so the design stays; generate the 3D model from the result. The design map's SIDE and BACK views are the turnaround reference for checking the 3D model.

wad_textures.how: For playing your own HERETIC.WAD: every file in references/textures and references/flats can be replaced. Name the HD file exactly like the original (e.g. textures/GRSTNPB.png) at 8x size.
wad_textures.prompt: seamless tileable PBR texture, realistic high-fidelity version of this exact texture, same layout, same colors, same stone/metal/wood pattern, flat even light, no baked shadows
wad_textures.img2img: init image: the original texture upscaled 8x; denoise 0.35-0.5; tiling on
